title: Unlocking collagen-derived novel antioxidant peptides from by-product bones of silver carp: label-free peptidomic discovery, bioinformatics-aided mechanistic elucidation, and cytoprotective effects against oxidative damage.
authors: Zhang, Jin; Lin, Feng; Mei, Yimeng; Xie, Ruoyu; Chen, Jiaxin; Hu, Jun; Du, Hongying; Hao, Guijie; Li, Shuangxi; Chen, Wenxuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鱼骨胶原抗氧化肽的发现与机制，涉及分子对接但对象为肽-Keap1蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Novel antioxidant peptides from silver carp bone collagen (SCBC) and their antioxidation mechanism were unlocked by integrating HPLC-MS/MS-based label-free peptidomics, bioinformatics-aided structure-function analysis, and cytoprotective validation against oxidative damage. Results showed that the ultrafiltrated </=1 kDa fraction contributed the highest in vitro antioxidant activities to SCBC hydrolysates by alpha-chymotrypsin and ficin, from which 349 peptides were identified through peptidomics. Nine antioxidant peptide candidates with high abundances were further selected by computer-aided screening and bioinformatic characterization, among which GSRGETGPAGR, GRVGPSGPAGAR, and AGEPGLVGAR exhibited both good DPPH*-scavenging (IC(50) = 775.37, 977.54, and 59.10 muM, respectively) and Fe(2+)-chelating (IC(50) = 47.22, 91.51, and 767.01 muM, respectively) capacities with IC(50) < 1 mM. The quantum chemical analysis suggested that peptide linkage acylamino or N-terminal amino groups were their redox-active sites. Moreover, the molecular docking analysis revealed that they may majorly form strong hydrogen bonds with core Arg415 within the Kelch domain of Keap1, thereby potentially disrupting the Keap1-Nrf2 interaction and activating the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway. Consequently, the production of antioxidant enzymes superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione peroxidase was facilitated, leading to the degradation of reactive oxygen species and reduction of malondialdehyde content, which significantly enhanced the viability of HepG2 cells against H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage. These findings offered insights into the high-value utilization of fish by-product bones and multi-dimensional mechanisms for food-derived antioxidant peptides.
abstract_zh: 通过整合基于HPLC-MS/MS的无标记肽组学、生物信息学辅助的结构-功能分析以及针对氧化损伤的细胞保护验证，揭示了来自鲢鱼骨胶原（SCBC）的新型抗氧化肽及其抗氧化机制。结果表明，超滤≤1 kDa组分对α-胰凝乳蛋白酶和无花果蛋白酶水解的SCBC水解物贡献了最高的体外抗氧化活性，并通过肽组学从中鉴定出349种肽。通过计算机辅助筛选和生物信息学表征，进一步选出了九种高丰度的抗氧化肽候选物，其中GSRGETGPAGR、GRVGPSGPAGAR和AGEPGLVGAR表现出良好的DPPH•清除能力（IC(50)分别为775.37、977.54和59.10 μM）和Fe²⁺螯合能力（IC(50)分别为47.22、91.51和767.01 μM），且IC(50) < 1 mM。量子化学分析表明，肽键的酰氨基或N端氨基基团是其氧化还原活性位点。此外，分子对接分析揭示，它们可能主要与Keap1 Kelch结构域内的核心Arg415形成强氢键，从而可能破坏Keap1-Nrf2相互作用并激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路。因此，促进了抗氧化酶超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶的生成，导致活性氧降解和丙二醛含量降低，显著增强了HepG2细胞抵抗H₂O₂诱导氧化损伤的活力。这些发现为鱼类副产物骨的高值化利用和食源性抗氧化肽的多维机制提供了见解。
